scope.basis: Blender offline render bridge, GOP6 video asset, and isolated preview route changed

claims.statement: The candidate uses Blender/Cycles UI-free PNG frames generated from the approved camera scheduler and current material manifest.
The candidate encodes the latest Blender frame set into a seekable H.264 MP4 with GOP 6 and no audio.
The isolated preview route loads the Blender poster/video and maps scroll progress to video seeking.
claims.consumer: Reviewer opening the candidate preview route

evidence_strategies.probe: local static server plus Playwright desktop/mobile screenshot and runtime hook checks

coverage.reason: The bridge validator checked scheduler/model/material hashes, Blender/Cycles UI-free render metadata, poster, and eight non-tiny PNG frames.

The encode manifest was regenerated from the current render manifest and the validator checked current render hash, MP4 hash, H.264 codec, frame count, dimensions, GOP6 policy, B-frame policy, fast-start flag, and keyframes.

A local byte-range static server and real Chrome loaded the candidate route on desktop and mobile; the MP4 returned 206, the seekable range covered the full duration, hook-based seeking changed currentTime, scroll changed currentTime again, and screenshots were captured.

evidence.target: Blender render frames, render manifest, encode manifest, poster, GOP6 MP4, and preview route source
evidence.summary: PASS: Blender offline render frames, GOP6 video, poster, and preview route are connected.
H.264 MP4, 960x600, 8 frames at 6 fps, GOP 6, 2 keyframes, no audio, no B-frames, fast-start, source render hash 77117e5f3caa7c91fd93a852127276bed69cab310be036a75a04a4b964ae3ab9.
The local review server returned HTTP 206 Partial Content, Content-Range bytes 0-1023/238471, Content-Type video/mp4, and Accept-Ranges bytes.

Chrome desktop and mobile loaded the page with no console errors or failed requests; MP4 response was 206; seekable range was 0-1.333333s; seekTo(0.75) reached currentTime about 0.999999s; scroll reached currentTime about 1.26s.

evidence.target: Desktop and mobile candidate preview states
evidence.summary: Screenshots were viewed for desktop initial/scroll and mobile initial/scroll states. The route renders nonblank Blender frames, HUD text remains in-bounds, and the mobile route now uses object-fit: contain to avoid extra crop of the offline frame.

findings.subject: local Blender rerender environment
findings.observed: The existing render manifest records Blender 5.2.0 LTS output, but no blender executable was found in PATH, Program Files, scoop apps, or common local Blender directories during this session.
findings.expected: A future full-quality render pass should run with an explicitly recorded Blender executable path or documented installation requirement.
findings.impact: The current bridge proof remains valid from existing Blender-rendered frames, but this session could not rerun Blender from a discovered executable path.
reproduction: Run where.exe blender from the repository root.
Search common Blender install directories if PATH lookup fails.

findings.subject: first proof frame composition
findings.observed: The first low-sample proof frame is an extreme core/edge close-up and has limited product legibility, especially before scrolling.
findings.expected: The final offline render should use approved responsive camera framing or a dedicated poster that preserves the intended subject on first view.
findings.impact: This does not block the technical bridge proof, but it should not be mistaken for final Hero art direction.

promotion_candidates.proposed_invariant: A Blender Hero bridge proof can pass only when the encode manifest sourceRenderManifestSha256 matches the current render manifest and the MP4 hash matches the encoded asset.
promotion_candidates.rationale: This caught the stale encode-manifest risk and is deterministic, scoped, low-cost, and decision-relevant for future preview passes.
